8502: Kneel on one knee and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in the hand opposite the raised knee.
Keep your torso tall and glutes tight.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower under control to your shoulder.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
8505: Kneel on both knees and hold one dumbbell with both hands beside one hip.
Twist and lift the dumbbell diagonally up across your body.
Reverse the path back down to the hip.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
8533: Kneel on both knees with your torso upright.
Step one foot forward and then the other so both feet are flat.
Press up to stand, then sit back into a squat.
8536: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a bit in front of you.
Lift your toes toward your shins as high as you can.
Keep the movement smooth and repeat.
8546: Lie face down with your forehead near the floor and arms extended overhead in a Y.
Lift your arms slightly and hold.
Move them out to a T, then bend the elbows into a W.
8585: Stand or sit tall with your hands by your head or elbows bent in front.
Pull your elbows back and down.
Hold for a second at the end.
